text:
Sam O: Heads-up — I have PR #8340 ready but there's a maintenance window tomorrow 04:00–06:00 UTC. Can we merge before the freeze or should I hold? CI currently running.
Priya K: What's the CI status? any flaky tests left? If tests are green we can try to sneak it in before the freeze, otherwise hold for the next rebase window.
Sam O: ci-bot just posted a failure on `integration/payment-flow` flaky on chrome-legacy. It failed twice.
ci-bot: test-suite:integration/payment-flow — FAILED (2/3 flakes) — rerun recommended
Tony L: If it's flaky twice it's risky to merge before maintenance. We could request a short rebase slot this afternoon. @Marta G can we fit Sam's PR into the 2pm rebase window?
Marta G: I only have 3 slots left today, 14:00 and 15:30 are open. Which one works for you, Sam?
Sam O: 14:00 UTC please. I'll rebase and run the local integration. If CI still flakes we should hold for post-maintenance rollout.
Priya K: Sweet. Sam, please run `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main` and push with `--force-with-lease`. Also trigger a soft rerun if the flaky test pops again:

```
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease origin HEAD:pr/8340
# then
/ci rerun pr 8340 --target=integration
```

Tony L: Also add a note in the PR description: "Requesting rebase slot 2024-09-09 14:00 UTC — merge contingent on green CI and no infra overrides." Helps oncall during the window.
Sam O: Will do. If CI goes green before 13:30 UTC I'll ping here and merge. If it flakes after rebase, I'll hold and reschedule.
deploy-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance: 2024-09-09 04:00–06:00 UTC. Code freeze active 03:30–06:30 UTC; emergency merges only.
Priya K: Good callout. Since maintenance is early morning, our 14:00 rebase slot is safe. But don't merge into main within 3h of the freeze.
Marta G: Confirmed slot at 14:00. I'll reserve it and stamp the PR once you push the rebase, Sam.
Sam O: Pushing rebase now, will report back in ~10m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ci-bot: queued: pr/8340 integration run — estimated 8m
